ns2:section.sectionText: All students must enroll in this lecture section (AL1) and one of lab sections (AB1or AB2) to complete registration in this course. Non-LIS graduate students and juniors and seniors must have permission of instructor to enroll (mwolske@uiuc.edu). Required travel at mid-semester and near end of semester. Syllabus will have course and travel details. Additional $25 course fee (non-waived) will be assessed to student's bill.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Library & Information Science major(s).
